mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, COALESCE(obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no) AS waybill_no ,o.store_id FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (o.order_no=#{reference} OR obr.tracking_no=#{reference} OR po.tracking_no=#{reference}) ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, order_no, waybill_no, status_code, title, description, location, source, occurred_at FROM ( SELECT -o.id AS id, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, COALESCE(obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no) AS waybill_no, 'ORDER_CREATED' AS status_code, '订单已创建' AS title, '物流订单创建完成' AS description, NULL AS location, 'INTERNAL' AS source, o.created_at AS occurred_at FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT -a.id, o.id, o.order_no, COALESCE(obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no), 'WAREHOUSE_INBOUND', '货物已入库', '仓库已确认收货', NULL, 'INTERNAL', a.occurred_at FROM audit_log a JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND o.id=a.resource_id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.resource_type='SHIPMENT_ORDER' AND a.resource_id=#{orderId} AND a.action_type='INBOUND' AND a.result_status='SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT -wm.id, o.id, o.order_no, COALESCE(obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no), 'WAREHOUSE_REWEIGH', '货物已复称', '仓库复称完成，计费重量已确认', NULL, 'INTERNAL', wm.measured_at FROM warehouse_measurement wm JOIN shipment_package sp ON sp.tenant_id=wm.tenant_id AND sp.id=wm.shipment_package_id JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=sp.tenant_id AND o.id=sp.shipment_order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE wm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT -obr.id, o.id, o.order_no, obr.tracking_no, 'WAREHOUSE_OUTBOUND_HANDOVER', '已出库交接', '仓库已完成出库并交接物流商', NULL, 'INTERNAL', obr.outbound_at FROM warehouse_outbound_record obr JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=obr.tenant_id AND o.id=obr.shipment_order_id WHERE obr.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND obr.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT e.id, o.id, o.order_no, COALESCE(e.waybill_no, obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no), e.status_code, e.title, e.description, e.location, e.source, e.occurred_at FROM shipment_tracking_event e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND o.id=e.order_id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT te.id, o.id, o.order_no, te.tracking_no, te.event_code, te.event_code, te.event_description, NULL, 'SF_EXPRESS', te.event_time FROM tracking_event te JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=te.tenant_id AND o.id=te.shipment_order_id WHERE te.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND te.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ) timeline ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT o.tenant_id, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, COALESCE(obr.tracking_no, po.tracking_no) AS waybill_no, o.current_status, o.version, COALESCE(NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(', ', receiver.city, receiver.address_line1), ''), '目的地收件地址') AS destination_address FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN shipment_address receiver ON receiver.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND receiver.shipment_order_id=o.id AND receiver.address_type='RECEIVER' WHERE o.current_status IN ('OUTBOUND', 'IN_TRANSIT') AND (o.order_no LIKE 'UAT-SF-%' OR po.test_flag=TRUE)

SELECT status_code FROM ( SELECT status_code, occurred_at, id FROM shipment_tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND source='SF_EXPRESS' UNION ALL SELECT event_code AS status_code, event_time AS occurred_at, id FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ) latest ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_tracking_event (tenant_id, order_id, order_no, waybill_no, status_code, title, description, location, source, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{waybillNo}, #{statusCode}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, 'SF_EXPRESS', #{occurredAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO exception_case (tenant_id, shipment_order_id, exception_no, exception_type, status, description, responsible_party, reported_at, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{exceptionNo}, 'TRANSPORT', 'OPEN', #{description}, 'PROVIDER', #{reportedAt}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, operator_user_id, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, result_status, reason, detail, occurred_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, NULL, 'EXCEPTION_SIMULATION_CREATE', 'EXCEPTION_CASE', ec.id, 'SF_TRACKING_SIMULATION', 'SUCCESS', #{description}, JSON_OBJECT('source', 'SF_TRACKING_SIMULATION', 'statusAfter', 'OPEN'), #{occurredAt} FROM exception_case ec WHERE ec.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ec.exception_no=#{exceptionNo}
